features.hold5: mean over j=t-4..t of 1[Cj>max(C[t-24:t-5])]; fixed resistance known before this 5-day window

high_delta_selection: Within same date, original PVR 2-point bin, exact I age, choose top half delta_amt by value then sid; require parent group>=8. Outcome independent.
pair: Extreme inward pair by feature within selected high-delta pool; exclude exact feature ties, report ties; no replacement for censoring.

candidates.E_support: E - amt_up_high*(1-hold5); only amount amplification on up-days is gated by prior-resistance acceptance
candidates.E_breakout: E - amt_up_high*1[break_distance<0]; sharp single-condition comparison, no weighted multi-feature sum

candidate_origin: Designed after original contribution outcomes and four-quadrant diagnosis. No claim of untouched time-out sample.
